title.suggested: Mike McCoole Recalls His Fights with Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted a New Orleans Picayune interview with Mike McCoole, who survived the Florence Meyer wreck and recounted his ring career, including his two fights with Tom Allen in St. Louis.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, October 20, 1880, page 3. Reprinted from the New Orleans Picayune.

facts.fact: McCoole recalled beating Allen in St. Louis in eight rounds and seventeen minutes
McCoole recalled losing his second fight with Allen, near St. Louis, in forty minutes, and said he had not fought since

notes: McCoole's dates are from memory: no year is given for the first Allen fight, and he puts the second in 1875, though the Allen-McCoole fight is usually dated 1873. Allen is only one paragraph of the interview.
